raw_response:
Let me think through this year's plan.

I am 58 now and only one person in the household — so with 40 mu I cannot do everything myself. Machinery I hire: rotary tiller, combine for wheat and maize, sowing machine. For cotton I still do the picking myself with some day labor at peak.

Cotton has been losing money the past few years — price is low and the labor is too heavy for me alone. Last year I had about 10 mu cotton and 30 mu in wheat-maize. This year I will keep it similar — 8 mu cotton because the land near the road is sandy and good for cotton, and 32 mu wheat-maize on the better flat land. I don't want to drop cotton completely because that ground doesn't grow wheat well.

**Wheat (32 mu, winter):** I sow around October 10, improved variety Jimai 22 like the village input dealer sells — most neighbors use it. Basal fertilizer I apply diammonium phosphate 2 bags per mu (one bag is 50 jin, so about 50 kg total diammonium per mu is too much — I mean 1 bag of diammonium per mu, 50 jin = 25 kg, gives about 4.5 kg N and 11 kg P). Then I topdress urea about 25 kg per mu at green-up in spring. Total N around 17 kg/mu. Potassium I add a little through compound fertilizer, maybe 5 kg/mu K. Irrigation: winter water, green-up, jointing, filling — 4 times with the well. Spray 2 times — once for aphids and once for scab if the weather is wet. Expect 480 kg/mu — last year I got 500 but don't want to promise that.

**Maize (32 mu, summer):** Direct seed right after wheat harvest in June, hybrid Zhengdan 958 or the newer one the dealer pushes. I put compound fertilizer 50 kg/mu at sowing, then topdress urea 20 kg/mu at big flare stage. That gives around 18 kg N, 7 kg P, 5 kg K per mu. Irrigate 2 times if rain is short. Spray once for corn borer, sometimes twice if armyworm comes. Expect 600 kg/mu.

**Cotton (8 mu, spring):** Transplant in late April. I use a Bt hybrid seed — bollworm is not the problem it used to be but I still buy Bt. Base fertilizer diammonium 30 kg/mu plus potassium sulfate 15 kg/mu (cotton needs potash or the bolls don't fill). Topdress urea 25 kg/mu at flowering. Total about 17 kg N, 7 kg P, 8 kg K. Irrigate 3 times. Spraying is the headache — aphids, mites, plant bugs — I count on 6 times through the season. Expect 230 kg/mu seed cotton, plough the ground in autumn after picking because cotton roots are deep.
